note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. The substituted datum is fictional; the animation shows only its geometric consequence (where the chain hooks) and infers no accuracy, validity or outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Lens on the original's numbered entries: the entry the treatise cites changes from 3 to 2; the clasp, eyelet and highlight move, the old hook stays as a dashed ghost with its number struck through.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the substituted datum is the page the note cites (p. 214 → p. 215). The lens isolates the open treatise's pages; the first chain's clasp moves to the passage on the facing page and the note's footnote text swaps in the context. Different fictional trail.
